payout_quote: If they join, we'll give you both a $50 bonus. ... The more friends you refer, the more bonuses you can receive. Earn up to $500 a month!
steps: Complete and submit the short referral form on secumd.org.
Your friend receives an email invitation to set up their SECU membership and open an account.
After their new accounts are open, you each receive $50.
catches: Cap: up to $500 per month in referral bonuses (10 referrals/month).
Friend must actually join and open accounts — no payout for incomplete signups.
SECU membership eligibility applies (Maryland-focused credit union); program terms can change.
Bonus payout timing not specified on the page.
biggest_catch: You only earn if your friend completes joining and opens accounts; capped at $500 per month.
eligibility: Existing SECU (Maryland) member; referred person must be eligible for SECU membership.
timing: Submit the form in ~5 minutes; bonus paid after the friend's accounts are open (timing not specified).
